title: npm client configured to write no lockfile
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that stops the lockfile being written or honoured. Every install resolves fresh from the registry, so two builds of the same commit can compile different code and no integrity value is recorded.
remediation: Enable the lockfile and commit it, so installs resolve from the recorded tree.
limitation: It matches a client setting that stops the lockfile being written or honoured in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
